org.primer.llm.usage: Tier-1 "neutral" colour ramp — nine stops, 100 (lightest) to 900 (darkest), backing the surface/ink/hairline role. Never referenced directly by a component: always through a tier-2 theme.color.background / content / border neutral-* semantic alias, so a brand can repoint the hue without touching component code. ONE ramp serves BOTH modes: light reads it from the top (100 = page, 900 = ink), dark reads it from the bottom. It replaced the split neutral-light/neutral-dark pair — nothing in tier-2 references those two any more.
